fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential evasion or obfuscation attempts using bogus path traversal via the commandline
fields.name: Potential Command Line Path Traversal Evasion Attempt
fields.notes:
- To move around freely without attracting too much attention, attackers often use reliable software (one of the favorites is psexec) that looks normal in an enterprise environment.
- Use the following aggregate to easily group by endpoint: `| group array_agg_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, src.process.cmdline`
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\Windows\" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\..\Windows\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\..\System32\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\..\..\")) or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".exe\..\") and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\Google\Drive\googledrivesync.exe\..\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\Citrix\Virtual Smart Card\Citrix.Authentication.VirtualSmartcard.Launcher.exe\..\"))))
